test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the total surface area (in cm²) of a cuboid having dimensions 5 cm, 7 cm and 11 cm.
solution:
Given:

Dimensions of cuboid = 5 cm × 7 cm × 11 cm 

Formula used:

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Calculation:

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(5 × 7 + 7 × 11 + 11 × 5)

⇒ 2(35 + 77 + 55)

⇒ 2 × 167 

⇒ 334 cm²

∴ The required result is 334 cm2.
